crossRefs.note: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome…

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”
translations.bsb: And the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Be still, since today is holy. Do not grieve.”
translations.kjv: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
translations.asv: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
